#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
NETWORK="etlnetwork" CONTAINER_NAME="dictionaryetl" PORT="8086" HEALTH_URL="http://${CONTAINER_NAME}:${PORT}/actuator/health" OUTFILE="container_ip_address.txt"
fail() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# --- Validate external shared network exists (do NOT recreate it in Jenkins) --- docker network inspect "$NETWORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 \ || fail "Required external Docker network '$NETWORK' does not exist. Create it outside Jenkins."
# --- Always remove existing container by name --- if docker container inspect "$CONTAINER_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Removing existing container: $CONTAINER_NAME" docker rm -f "$CONTAINER_NAME" fi
# --- Rebuild and recreate container --- docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate
# --- Wait for DNS + HTTP health --- for _ in {1..30}; do if docker run --rm --network "$NETWORK" curlimages/curl:8.6.0 \ sh -lc 'getent hosts "'"$CONTAINER_NAME"'" >/dev/null && curl -fsS --max-time 3 "'"$HEALTH_URL"'" >/dev/null' then ip="$(docker inspect "$CONTAINER_NAME" | jq -r '.[0].NetworkSettings.Networks["'"$NETWORK"'"].IPAddress // empty')" [[ -n "$ip" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$ip" | tee "$OUTFILE" >/dev/null || true echo "$CONTAINER_NAME started and is reachable." exit 0 fi sleep 2 done
echo "Container logs:" docker logs "$CONTAINER_NAME" || true
fail "$CONTAINER_NAME did not become reachable at $HEALTH_URL on network $NETWORK"
